data.one_liner: Provides a ShakeWidget to apply shake animations to any Flutter widget.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a ShakeWidget that animates its child with various shake patterns. It includes several built‑in shake constants and allows custom shake definitions.
use_when: you need a quick attention‑grabbing shake effect
showing validation errors or emphasizing UI elements
avoid_when: you require complex or non‑shake animations
performance‑critical scenarios needing fine‑tuned animation control
strengths: very easy to drop into existing code
weaknesses: no code generation or advanced animation features

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a simple visual attention effect without custom animation code
